_description: Live log generators for `tail -f`. Each generator produces randomized log lines on an interval. Add new generators to expand. Referenced by VFS nodes with `_live: true` and `_generator: <key>`.

generator.prefix: string — tag shown in brackets before each line
generator.messages: array of strings — one picked at random each interval tick. Use {rand_N} for random int 1-N, {rand_float_N} for float.
